notes.title: Demo update #2
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]I present to you a small but very important update for [b]Sister Ray[/b], mainly focused on the gameplay depth in a "sober" playthrough.[/p][p][b]Major changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A medicine specifically for restoring health is now available in the drugstore - "[b]Magnesium+B6[/b]". It is sold for [b]$20[/b], but has [b]6[/b] uses, restores [b]1[/b] health for each.[/p][/*][*][p]Items that restore health now say how much health they restore.[/p][/*][*][p]The "[b]Heart Failure[/b]" status can now be removed with [b]Magnesium[/b] (status description updated).[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum withdrawal is now [b]13/10[/b], the upper limit goes up to [b]20[/b], increasing with the Level of chemistry.[/p][/*][*][p]Each day of sobriety increases the effect of everything that removes withdrawal (you can go from the maximum to zero in one use, returning to the dark path).[/p][/*][*][p]Drawing in a state of withdrawal will become a little more difficult, but more interesting, because dots that need to be avoided will sometimes appear on the paper.[/p][/*][*][p]At any amount of withdrawal, you can now go to the "[b]normal[/b]" state by raising your composure to [b]9[/b] or higher. In the normal state, the mini-game in the dialogues is absent and the complication of drawing from the previous point is practically reduced to nothing.[/p][/*][*][p]To make it easier to maintain a normal state, the duration of positive statuses has been slightly increased. Also, coffee can now give "[b]Concentration[/b]" status, which significantly increases composure.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The "softlock" has been fixed, when you die immediately after saving the game. Now after death, the last good save is always loaded. I case your game is already in this state, you need to load the last good save (for example, an autosave at the beginning of the day) yourself.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when it was impossible to buy cigarettes if they were already in the inventory, and the inventory was full.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes in dialogues.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The first update for the Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/52beb535e9772388c48ba53817cc4008228bf510.png[/img]
Hey everyone,

I am glad to present you with the first update, which adds more explanations on game mechanics, and also fixes some serious problems.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] A lot of text corrections.
[*] Added an explanation for the composure check mechanic in dialogues (during the first few checks at the beginning of the game).
[*] Composure check has been moved closer to the dialogue window on widescreen monitors.
[*] Added an explanation for each of the four main characteristics.
[*] The description of temporary statuses now displays the approximate time for how long this status will be active.
[*] After painting on the first day, an explanation has been added about why it might be useful to throw away the paintings.
[*] Fixed a bug when, upon increasing the game's framerate, the cursor movement during sketching slowed down significantly.
[*] Fixed a softlock on the morning of the third day, if the sister got angry and went to her room. (After the update, you need to load any backup save made by the game)
[/list]
Thank you for your support!
[b]Leave a review on the demo page. It will help greatly![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641710/

notes.title: Sister Ray Demo Release + Games From Russia 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/3eb51b6bdee936748b5529c6349d995fde9c3ec4.png[/img]
[h3]Good news everyone![/h3]

From May 1 to 9, [b]Sister Ray[/b] is taking part in the festival [b]Games From Russia 2025[/b]!

And I'm very excited to announce the release of [b]Sister Ray: A Walk on the Wild Side[/b] - demo featuring the first chapter of the game, one week in the life of Ray - an artist suffering from addiction and her younger sister named Lilah.

The choice of how to live this week is entirely up to you. Improve your drawing skills, spend time with memorable characters, look for ways to ease the withdrawal and improve your well-being - the story will not leave you indifferent!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641710/

I kindly ask you to leave a review on the steam page. I can't even describe how important this is for the game.

notes.title: Sister Ray Demo Announcement and Meeting the Characters!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I am extremely happy to announce that the demo of Sister Ray is coming out on May 1st!
Add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned for more news!

In the meantime, you can learn a little about the main characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/4f2cdac5eac1717a0c0ed2c9a68a5152a60baf89.png[/img]
Meet Rachel Birch, the most irresponsible person in the world. She will have to take care of her younger sister when her parents are gone.
She tries to become an artist, but nothing really works out - either she lacks talent or hard work.
One way or another, she will get into trouble, where she will not be able to get out of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/8fd4874ff1c12537e7974b9b988e5d08e17ce040.png[/img]
Lilah, the little sister. Capricious and always dissatisfied with everything, she can never choose between dozens of different hobbies. It will not be easy to approach her. And she will quickly borrow any bad habits from Ray.
Ray and Lilah are half-sisters, they have the same father. They did not see each other very often and do not know each other very well, and therefore they will have to build a relationship practically from scratch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/6e2c4a9607b1d8742a03058ed6bd56c2fff4a59d.png[/img]
This is Martha, our best friend. She is the one who introduces us to the world of the forbidden and illegal. She knows everything that happens on the streets.
She hates the name Martha, she calls herself Molly. She is studying to be a journalist and is doing her own "investigation" for her term paper.
She has been having huge problems lately. It is up to us to decide whether to help her or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/34687accf05020a0cc3c39d38fdb878dcf022050.png[/img]
The next important character is Waldo, a young guy who is wasting his life.
He once wanted to become a writer, but now he has lost his talent. Constant fights, alcohol and problems have now become a habit for him.
Nobody knows the reasons for his self-destructive behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/58b89ecb9c5bc623a3281e69296726fa2c149bce.png[/img]
The last of the main characters is Candy. A representative of the oldest profession and a suspiriac (the meaning of the term will become obvious in the game, but it is not difficult to guess).
She does not have a home and sleeps wherever she can, even on a bench, covered with newspapers.
Candy, of course, is not her real name. She will reveal the real one only to those whom she truly trusts. So far, there have been no such people in her life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/f90bbc06540d7cd1f4e046330fe39f06640ec57b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/9a3acd9c48af209b72bdeddad001a7e8e103c180.png[/img]
Two musicians - Jimmy (guitar) and Jude (bass). Always arguing about the tastes and the music of different bands, neither one will ever convince the other. They play in the local bar Purple Haze.
During the day, Jude works in a pawn shop, where he sells various trinkets. He also collects rare music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/c063aaf561b36649830abb49468ce09d9017a589.png[/img]
In her free time, Sheila is involved in magical and spiritual practices, reads tarot cards, and helps us using her rituals.
She works in a pharmacy and is extremely concerned about both our physical and spiritual health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/7cd41b501030e2b71ae4ea371c68357015cd3300.png[/img]
Priscilla is a bartender at Purple Haze. She's a chatterbox and knows everything that's going on around, which means you can always find out the latest rumors and gossip from her.
And of course, she invites us to try her cocktails.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45202145/56b3371392f9aac0188fb99f08fa858fa33297af.png[/img]
Jack and Tina are an inseparable and dangerous couple (they will always be together even in the portrait).
They usually ignore us and it will not be easy to find a way to approach them.
